You will compare one known error in a data agent's work against a list of items produced by a reviewer. Each item was written for a group of tables rather than for a single table; the name of the group is given before each item. Your job is to decide whether any item identifies this known error for the table named below.

An item identifies the known error only if all of these hold:
- Its group includes the table named below, as far as you can tell from the group name and the item text. If you cannot tell whether the table is in the group, the item does not count.
- It is about the same thing: the same column, computation, filter, or join, as it applies to this table. An item that describes a column or step shared by the group covers this table's instance of it.
- It points to the same problem: what the item says is wrong, assumed, or missing is the same as what went wrong in the known error. It does not matter whether the item is phrased as an assumption the agent made or as a problem in the work; judge by meaning.

An item does not count if it only says that something may be wrong without saying what. An item about the same column but a different problem does not count.

If more than one item identifies the error, report the first one in the list. If you are unsure, say so rather than guessing.

Return a JSON object with:
- "verdict": "match", "no_match", or "unsure".
- "position": the position of the matching item in the list (1 is the first), or null.
- "quote": the exact words from the matching item that show it identifies the error, or null.
- "reason": one short sentence.

=== Known error ===
Table: int_pendo__product_health_metrics
What the agent's work assumed: feature 和 engagement 两部分直接按账户和应用连接就行
What was actually required or true: 先与账户 retention 做全外连接，再接 engagement

=== Reviewer's items for groups of tables (not ranked) ===
Group: marts.pendo__customer_lifecycle_insights
{
  "position": 1,
  "item": {
    "statement": "Joining lifecycle and RFM rows by visitor_id and product-health rows by account_id does not multiply visitor rows.",
    "about": "data",
    "target": "marts.pendo__customer_lifecycle_insights",
    "evidence_of_dependence": "LEFT JOIN intermediate.int_pendo__user_lifecycle_segments l USING(visitor_id) LEFT JOIN intermediate.int_pendo__customer_rfm_analysis r USING(visitor_id) LEFT JOIN intermediate.int_pendo__product_health_metrics h ON v.account_id=h.account_id",
    "alternative": "Lifecycle documentation says \"a visitor may appear multiple times across accounts\"; RFM has visitor-account grain and product health has account-app grain, while this mart requires \"exactly one output row per visitor_id\".",
    "reason": "Multiple matches can multiply customer records and combine attributes from different account scopes.",
    "updates": null,
    "id": "c11-1",
    "call": 11
  }
}

Group: marts.pendo__customer_lifecycle_insights
{
  "position": 2,
  "item": {
    "statement": "Every customer may receive the default next-action recommendation without evaluating the specified action rules.",
    "about": "requirement",
    "target": "marts.pendo__customer_lifecycle_insights.recommended_next_action",
    "evidence_of_dependence": "'Standard nurturing; Regular check-ins; Content engagement' recommended_next_action",
    "alternative": "The contract requires ordered recommendations including \"Immediate intervention; Executive outreach; Value demonstration\" for High Risk customers.",
    "reason": "Recommendations ignore the customer signals that are supposed to determine intervention.",
    "updates": null,
    "id": "c11-3",
    "call": 11
  }
}

Group: marts.pendo__customer_lifecycle_insights
{
  "position": 3,
  "item": {
    "statement": "Customer segment classification requires only the first three specified rules before defaulting to Standard Customer.",
    "about": "requirement",
    "target": "marts.pendo__customer_lifecycle_insights.customer_segment_label",
    "evidence_of_dependence": "WHEN l.lifecycle_stage='New User' AND r.rfm_segment='New Customers' THEN 'Fresh Prospect' ELSE 'Standard Customer'",
    "alternative": "The contract additionally specifies \"Rising Star\", \"Save Immediately\", \"Rescue Mission\", and \"Lost Customer\" before the default.",
    "reason": "Entire growth and risk segments cannot appear in the output.",
    "updates": null,
    "id": "c11-2",
    "call": 11
  }
}

Group: marts.pendo__customer_lifecycle_insights
{
  "position": 4,
  "item": {
    "statement": "Every customer may be assigned Maintenance without evaluating the customer-journey rules.",
    "about": "requirement",
    "target": "marts.pendo__customer_lifecycle_insights.customer_journey_stage",
    "evidence_of_dependence": "'Maintenance' customer_journey_stage",
    "alternative": "The contract requires ordered \"Onboarding\", \"Growth\", \"Maturity\", \"Retention\", and \"Win-back\" rules before Maintenance.",
    "reason": "The output loses all required distinctions between customer journey stages.",
    "updates": null,
    "id": "c11-4",
    "call": 11
  }
}

Group: marts.pendo__customer_lifecycle_insights
{
  "position": 5,
  "item": {
    "statement": "Every customer may be assigned Standard LTV without evaluating the predicted-LTV rules.",
    "about": "requirement",
    "target": "marts.pendo__customer_lifecycle_insights.predicted_ltv_tier",
    "evidence_of_dependence": "'Standard LTV' predicted_ltv_tier",
    "alternative": "The contract specifies \"Very High LTV\", \"High LTV\", \"Moderate LTV\", and \"Low LTV\" conditions before the default.",
    "reason": "The required value and risk distinctions cannot influence predicted lifetime value.",
    "updates": null,
    "id": "c11-5",
    "call": 11
  }
}

Group: marts.pendo__executive_dashboard_metrics
{
  "position": 6,
  "item": {
    "statement": "The executive dashboard may omit the product-health source and leave all four platform health averages null.",
    "about": "requirement",
    "target": "marts.pendo__executive_dashboard_metrics",
    "evidence_of_dependence": "NULL::DOUBLE avg_platform_health_score,NULL::DOUBLE avg_platform_nps,NULL::DOUBLE avg_feature_adoption,NULL::DOUBLE avg_retention_rate",
    "alternative": "The contract requires account history to be left joined to \"intermediate.int_pendo__product_health_metrics\", per-account maxima, and platform averages of those metrics.",
    "reason": "The dashboard omits its required product-health and customer-sentiment inputs.",
    "updates": null,
    "id": "c11-6",
    "call": 11
  }
}

Group: marts.pendo__executive_dashboard_metrics
{
  "position": 7,
  "item": {
    "statement": "The executive dashboard may always report All Systems Normal without evaluating alert conditions.",
    "about": "requirement",
    "target": "marts.pendo__executive_dashboard_metrics.primary_alert_status",
    "evidence_of_dependence": "'All Systems Normal' primary_alert_status",
    "alternative": "The contract requires ordered alerts for account risk, customer satisfaction, growth decline, retention, and customer health before the default.",
    "reason": "Required business alerts cannot be surfaced regardless of the source metrics.",
    "updates": null,
    "id": "c11-10",
    "call": 11
  }
}

Group: marts.pendo__executive_dashboard_metrics
{
  "position": 8,
  "item": {
    "statement": "All executive account-risk counts may be zero without classifying the accounts.",
    "about": "requirement",
    "target": "marts.pendo__executive_dashboard_metrics.high_risk_accounts, medium_risk_accounts, low_risk_accounts",
    "evidence_of_dependence": "0::BIGINT high_risk_accounts,0::BIGINT medium_risk_accounts,0::BIGINT low_risk_accounts",
    "alternative": "The contract requires counts of accounts labeled \"High/Medium/Low Risk\" after applying ordered account-risk rules.",
    "reason": "No account can contribute to any risk category, including the required Low Risk default.",
    "updates": null,
    "id": "c11-7",
    "call": 11
  }
}

Group: marts.pendo__executive_dashboard_metrics
{
  "position": 9,
  "item": {
    "statement": "The executive dashboard may report zero seven-day growth and Concerning Decline without calculating the recent and prior seven-day averages.",
    "about": "requirement",
    "target": "marts.pendo__executive_dashboard_metrics.user_growth_rate_7d, growth_trend_assessment",
    "evidence_of_dependence": "0::DOUBLE user_growth_rate_7d,'Concerning Decline' growth_trend_assessment",
    "alternative": "The contract defines growth as the difference between recent and prior seven-day average daily users divided by the prior average, with classification based on the raw result.",
    "reason": "Observed user growth cannot change either reported trend output.",
    "updates": null,
    "id": "c11-8",
    "call": 11
  }
}

Group: marts.pendo__executive_dashboard_metrics
{
  "position": 10,
  "item": {
    "statement": "The overall business health score may remain null without evaluating its weighted formula.",
    "about": "requirement",
    "target": "marts.pendo__executive_dashboard_metrics.overall_business_health_score",
    "evidence_of_dependence": "NULL::DOUBLE overall_business_health_score",
    "alternative": "The contract requires a capped weighted composite of health, NPS, adoption, retention, conversion, and growth, becoming null only when a non-growth component is null.",
    "reason": "The executive score is an unconditional placeholder rather than a calculated KPI.",
    "updates": null,
    "id": "c11-9",
    "call": 11
  }
}

Group: marts.pendo__product_adoption_analytics
{
  "position": 11,
  "item": {
    "statement": "Historical feature and page joins produce at most one matching row for each usage pair within each final feature-attribute group.",
    "about": "data",
    "target": "marts.pendo__product_adoption_analytics",
    "evidence_of_dependence": "sum(u.ev) ev,sum(u.mins) mins,sum(u.days) days FROM u LEFT JOIN h USING(feature_id) LEFT JOIN p USING(page_id) GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5,6,7",
    "alternative": "The contract explicitly allows \"Multiple historical rows per feature_id\" and says duplicate feature-info rows should leave averages unchanged; this code sums replicated usage before averaging.",
    "reason": "Historical duplicates can inflate per-user totals and active days and change regular-user classification.",
    "updates": null,
    "id": "c11-11",
    "call": 11
  }
}

Group: marts.pendo__product_adoption_analytics
{
  "position": 12,
  "item": {
    "statement": "Every feature ID in feature-event usage has a matching feature-history row.",
    "about": "data",
    "target": "marts.pendo__product_adoption_analytics.feature_id",
    "evidence_of_dependence": "SELECT h.feature_id ... FROM u LEFT JOIN h USING(feature_id)",
    "alternative": "The contract starts from usage and requires a \"Left join feature_usage_base to feature_info on feature_id\", retaining the usage feature identifier even without metadata.",
    "reason": "Unmatched usage loses its feature identifier and different unmatched features can be merged.",
    "updates": null,
    "id": "c11-12",
    "call": 11
  }
}

Group: marts.pendo__product_adoption_summary
{
  "position": 13,
  "item": {
    "statement": "Every feature-account-app group has at least one non-null num_events value when computing feature health.",
    "about": "data",
    "target": "marts.pendo__product_adoption_summary.feature_health_score",
    "evidence_of_dependence": "least(100,count(DISTINCT visitor_id)*2+avg(num_events)*5+count(DISTINCT CAST(occurred_at AS DATE))*3) feature_health_score",
    "alternative": "The contract states \"if there are no non-NULL num_events the score is NULL\"; DuckDB's LEAST can return 100 when the other argument is null.",
    "reason": "An all-null event-count group can receive the maximum score instead of a null score.",
    "updates": null,
    "id": "c11-13",
    "call": 11
  }
}
